caseTitle.en: A day on the screening van

condition.zh: 篩檢 · 偽陽性與基礎率
condition.en: Screening · false positives and base rates

tagline.zh: 陽性是一張回診單，不是一張診斷書
tagline.en: A positive screen is a recall slip, not a diagnosis

desc.zh: 跟著邱醫師算二乘二表、把「需回診」說成人聽得懂的話、安排沒來的人。
desc.en: Work the two-by-two table with Dr Chiu, turn “recall” into words a person can carry home, and plan for the people who did not come.

desc.zh: 攝影車的品管、擺位、影像品質與上傳都在你手上；每一位阿姨進去前，你先數到三。
desc.en: Quality control, positioning, image quality and upload on the van are yours; before every woman steps in, you count to three.

about.zh: 口袋裡永遠有一張對折的二乘二表。口頭禪：陽性是一張回診單，不是一張診斷書。
about.en: Always has a folded two-by-two table in her pocket. Catchphrase: a positive is a recall slip, not a diagnosis.

about.zh: 乳房攝影車開了十年。每一位阿姨進去前他都先說：會夾一下，我數到三。
about.en: Ten years on the mammography van. Before every woman steps in: it will pinch a little, I'll count to three.

about.zh: 採血站的主人。桌上有一盒糖果，不是給自己吃的。
about.en: Runs the blood station. Keeps a box of sweets on the desk, and they are not for her.

role.zh: 五十五歲，今天攝影「需回診」

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。手機裡存了十篇文章，標題都有「癌」字。去年沒來，今年被女兒押來。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Ten articles saved on her phone, every title with the word cancer. Skipped last year; marched here by her daughter this year.

role.en: Seventy, fasting for the blood test

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。為了抽血從昨晚十點空腹，早上還先巡了田。有糖尿病，藥照吃。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Fasting since ten last night for the test, and checked his fields first thing. Has diabetes; took his tablet as usual.

about.zh: 名單上有十二位阿姨沒來，其中六位住在山上那條沒有公車的路。
about.en: Twelve women on the list did not come; six of them live up the road with no bus.

about.zh: 需回診的人由她安排進一步檢查。她也想知道今天會有幾位。
about.en: Arranges the diagnostic work-up for every recall. She also wants to know how many to expect today.

plain.zh: 在沒有症狀的人裡找早期病變。對象是健康的人，所以每一個偽陽性都是一個被嚇到的健康人。
plain.en: Looking for early disease in people without symptoms. The subjects are healthy, so every false positive is a healthy person frightened.

plain.zh: 真正有病的人裡，檢查能抓到幾成。
plain.en: Of the people who truly have the disease, the share the test catches.

plain.zh: 真正沒病的人裡，檢查能正確放過幾成。
plain.en: Of the people who truly do not have it, the share the test correctly clears.

plain.zh: 受檢的人裡，真正有病的比例。它很低，所以陽性裡大多是偽陽性。
plain.en: The share of those screened who truly have the disease. It is low, which is why most positives are false.

plain.zh: 檢查說陽性的人裡，真正有病的比例。它看盛行率的臉色，不只看靈敏度。
plain.en: Of those the test calls positive, the share who truly have the disease. It depends on prevalence, not just on sensitivity.

plain.zh: 沒有病，檢查卻說陽性。篩檢裡最常見的結果之一，不是失誤。
plain.en: No disease, but the test says positive. One of the commonest screening outcomes, not a mistake.

plain.zh: 影像上有地方需要再看清楚，請回來做進一步檢查。它是一張回診單，不是診斷。
plain.en: Something on the image needs a closer look; please come back for further tests. A recall slip, not a diagnosis.

plain.zh: 回診後做的詳細檢查：加照、超音波、必要時切片。篩檢找線索，確診檢查給答案。
plain.en: The detailed tests after a recall: extra views, ultrasound, a biopsy if needed. Screening finds clues; the work-up gives the answer.

plain.zh: 上一次篩檢陰性、下一次之前就出現的癌。所以陰性不是保證，摸到硬塊就要就醫。
plain.en: A cancer that appears after a negative screen and before the next one. A negative is not a guarantee; a lump still means a doctor.

plain.zh: 篩檢找到一輩子都不會造成問題的病變，卻讓人接受治療。篩檢的代價之一。
plain.en: Screening finds a lesion that would never have caused harm, and the person is treated anyway. One of screening's costs.

plain.zh: 早發現讓「確診後活的時間」變長，但不一定讓人活得更久。比較存活時要小心這個錯覺。
plain.en: Finding a disease earlier lengthens the time lived after diagnosis without necessarily lengthening life. Beware this illusion when comparing survival.

plain.zh: 血糖太低：冒冷汗、發抖、頭暈、說話不清。空腹抽血還照吃降血糖藥的人最容易發生。
plain.en: Blood sugar too low: sweating, shaking, dizziness, slurred words. Commonest in someone fasting for a blood test who still took the diabetes tablet.

plain.zh: 每一位受檢者之前與之後都要洗手或乾洗手。篩檢車也是醫療場所。
plain.en: Wash or rub hands before and after every person. A screening van is a clinical setting too.

plain.zh: 服務好不好到達：有沒有車、有沒有時間、有沒有人陪。沒來的人，常常不是不想來。
plain.en: How reachable a service is: a bus, a free morning, someone to come along. People who do not turn up often wanted to.

text.zh: 一台攝影機、一間更衣室、一台發電機。每天開工前先拍品管假體，影像合格才開門。
text.en: One mammography unit, one changing cubicle, one generator. Every morning starts with a phantom image; the doors open only when it passes.

text.zh: 每一位受檢者一列：身分、日期、結果、是否需回診、回診是否完成。最後一欄最常空著。
text.en: One row per person: identity, date, result, recall or not, recall completed or not. The last column is the one most often left blank.

text.zh: 血糖機、血壓計、糖果、一張椅子。椅子有扶手，是因為有人會暈。
text.en: Glucometer, blood pressure cuff, sweets, one chair. The chair has arms because people faint.

text.zh: 核對身分、問上次篩檢、問有沒有症狀。有症狀的人不走篩檢，直接轉診。
text.en: Check identity, ask about the last screen, ask about symptoms. Someone with symptoms does not go through screening; they go straight to referral.

text.zh: 邱醫師口袋裡那張。四格、兩條線、一行鉛筆字：「先問盛行率」。今天給你了。
text.en: The one from Dr Chiu's pocket. Four cells, two lines, one pencilled note: “ask the prevalence first”. Yours now.

name.zh: 九成靈敏度為什麼不是九成確診
name.en: Why ninety percent sensitive is not ninety percent sure

text.zh: 一千個沒症狀的人裡，真正有病的也許只有五個。九成靈敏度抓到其中四、五個；九成特異度卻讓將近一百個沒病的人變陽性。所以陽性裡真正有病的不到一成。這不是檢查爛，是盛行率低。要讓陽性預測值變高，先選對受檢的人。
text.en: Among a thousand people without symptoms, perhaps five truly have the disease. Ninety percent sensitivity catches four or five of them; ninety percent specificity turns nearly a hundred healthy people positive. So fewer than one in ten positives is real. The test is not bad; the prevalence is low. To raise the positive predictive value, choose the right people to screen.

text.zh: 過度診斷：找到一輩子不會作怪的病變，人卻被治療了。導前時間偏差：早發現讓「確診後」的年數變長，看起來像活得久，其實只是提早知道。評價篩檢要看死亡率有沒有降，不只看存活年數。
text.en: Overdiagnosis: a lesion that would never have mattered is found, and the person is treated. Lead-time bias: finding it earlier lengthens the years after diagnosis, which looks like longer life but is only earlier knowledge. Judge a screening programme by whether deaths fall, not by survival years alone.

name.en: The people who did not come

text.zh: 篩檢率是平均。沒來的人常常是最需要的人：沒有車、沒有假、沒有人陪、看不懂通知。把車開上山，比再寄一張通知有用。
text.en: A screening rate is an average. Those who do not come are often those who need it most: no bus, no day off, nobody to come along, a letter they could not read. Driving the van up the hill works better than posting another letter.

guide.en: Find Dr Chiu at the check-in desk

lines.zh: 活動中心前的停車場，早上七點半。乳房攝影車的發電機剛轉起來，阿德在裡面拍品管假體。
lines.en: The car park outside the community hall, half past seven. The van's generator has just started; inside, Te is imaging the phantom.

lines.zh: 今天一百二十位阿姨的乳房攝影，六十位的血糖血壓。篩檢的第一件事不是機器，是名單。
lines.en: Today: mammograms for a hundred and twenty women, glucose and blood pressure for sixty. The first thing in screening is not the machine. It is the list.

lines.zh: 糖果補好了。去年用掉兩盒。
lines.en: Sweets restocked. We went through two boxes last year.

lines.zh: 登錄工作站在哪？條碼貼紙和名單要對上。
lines.en: Where is the registry workstation? The barcode labels and the list have to match.

q.zh: 找到篩檢登錄工作站，核對名單與條碼貼紙
q.en: Find the registry workstation and match the list to the barcode labels

post.zh: 一百二十個名字，一百二十張貼紙。最後一欄「回診完成」全部空白。
post.en: A hundred and twenty names, a hundred and twenty labels. The last column, recall completed, is all blank.

post.zh: 那一欄才是今天真正的工作。
post.en: That column is today's real job.

guide.en: Run the start-up checks with Te

lines.zh: 品管假體合格了。接下來每一位的流程，你排一次。
lines.en: The phantom passed. Now lay out the sequence for every woman who steps in.

q.zh: 攝影車每一位受檢者的流程
q.en: The sequence for each woman on the van

steps.zh: 檢查影像品質，必要時重拍
steps.en: Check image quality; repeat if needed

post.zh: 重拍不是失敗。模糊的片子送出去才是。
post.en: A repeat is not a failure. Sending out a blurred image is.

lines.zh: 開工前先猜：一百二十位，大約幾位需回診？幾位最後真的有病？
lines.en: Before we start, a guess: of a hundred and twenty, roughly how many recalls, and how many will truly have the disease?

lines.zh: 需回診大概不到十位。真的有病，可能一位，也可能零位。
lines.en: Recalls, under ten. True disease, perhaps one, perhaps none.

lines.zh: 對。把這個數字記在心裡，下午跟阿姨講話時會用到。
lines.en: Right. Keep those numbers in mind; you will need them when you talk to the women this afternoon.

note.zh: 乾洗手六步；空腹的陷阱
note.en: Six-step hand rub; the fasting trap

lines.zh: 每一位之前、之後，手部衛生。篩檢車也是醫療場所。
lines.en: Before and after every person, hand hygiene. The van is a clinical setting.

lines.zh: 六步驟，搓到乾。你先。
lines.en: Six steps, rub until dry. You first.

post.zh: 指縫和拇指，大家最常漏。
post.en: Between the fingers and the thumbs. Everyone misses those.

guide.en: Check on Old Tsai in the chair

lines.zh: 我昨晚十點就沒吃了，藥有吃。早上先去看田，現在有點晃。
lines.en: Nothing since ten last night, took my tablet though. Checked the fields this morning. Bit wobbly now.

lines.zh: 他的額頭冒汗，手指在抖，話開始接不上。
lines.en: Sweat on his forehead, fingers trembling, his sentences starting to drift.

options.zh: 測血糖、給糖、坐著觀察、不讓他騎車走
options.en: Check glucose, give sugar, sit and observe, no riding home

why.zh: 空腹加降血糖藥加勞動，低血糖是第一個要排除的。先給糖，數字再補。
why.en: Fasting plus a diabetes tablet plus field work: hypoglycaemia comes first. Sugar first, the number after.
The specimen can wait. A collapse cannot.

why.zh: 他會在半路暈倒，而且是騎機車。
why.en: He will faint on the way, and he is on a scooter.

post.zh: 血糖很低。糖果果然不是給自己吃的。
post.en: Glucose very low. Told you the sweets weren't for me.

post.zh: 空腹篩檢的陷阱。通知單上要寫：空腹是不吃東西，降血糖藥先問醫師。
post.en: The fasting trap. The invitation letter must say: fasting means no food, and ask your doctor about the diabetes tablet.

post.zh: 田可以等。您坐半小時，血糖穩了我們再談田。
post.en: The fields can wait. Sit for half an hour; when your sugar is steady, we will talk about the fields.

guide.zh: 到攝影車看阿德的螢幕
guide.en: Look at Te's console on the van

lines.zh: 這一位，右側有一塊不對稱的緻密影，系統標「需回診」。她剛剛看到我的表情了。
lines.en: This one: an asymmetric density on the right. System flags recall. And she just saw my face.

lines.zh: 是不是有東西？你們不用騙我。
lines.en: There's something, isn't there? You don't have to lie to me.

lines.zh: 先搞清楚，「需回診」在篩檢裡是什麼意思？你來。
lines.en: First get clear on what “recall” means in screening. You take it.

post.zh: 篩檢的陽性，是「要再看清楚」，不是「有病」。這句話要講得像你真的相信，因為它是真的。
post.en: A positive screen means “we need a closer look”, not “you have the disease”. Say it as if you believe it, because it is true.

lines.zh: 我手機裡那些文章都說，九成準確。九成耶。
lines.en: All those articles on my phone say ninety percent accurate. Ninety.

q.zh: 美玉阿姨在報到桌前問：「是不是我得癌症了？」你怎麼做？
q.en: At the check-in desk Auntie Mei-Yu asks: “Do I have cancer?” What do you do?

options.zh: 到隔間坐下，說明回診不是診斷，當場約確診檢查
options.en: Sit her down privately, explain recall is not diagnosis, book the work-up now

why.zh: 隱私、說明、下一步，三件事一次做完。大部分回診的人最後沒有病。
why.en: Privacy, explanation, next step, all at once. Most people recalled turn out not to have the disease.

options.en: Ninety percent accurate, so probably yes

why.zh: 九成靈敏度不等於九成確診。盛行率低，陽性大多是偽陽性。
why.en: Ninety percent sensitive is not ninety percent sure. With low prevalence, most positives are false.

options.en: Go home and wait for the letter

why.zh: 她會帶著那十篇文章回家，整夜不睡。沉默會被文章填滿。
why.en: She will take those ten articles home and not sleep. Silence gets filled by the articles.

post.zh: 所以……十個被叫回去的人，有九個沒事？
post.en: So… of ten people called back, nine are fine?

post.zh: 差不多。要再看清楚，是為了那一個。我們現在就把回診約好。
post.en: About that. The closer look is for the one. Let's book the appointment right now.

guide.zh: 到閱片螢幕看乳房影像
guide.en: Look at the breast image on the viewer

lines.zh: 為什麼乳房攝影上的「異常」，大多最後不是癌？看影像想一想。
lines.en: Why does an “abnormality” on a mammogram so often turn out not to be cancer? Look at the image and think.

question.zh: 乳房攝影上的「異常」為什麼大多不是癌？
question.en: Why are most “abnormalities” on a screening mammogram not cancer?

answer.zh: 乳腺、纖維組織、囊腫與鈣化都會在片子上變白、重疊，看起來像不對稱的緻密影。篩檢對象沒有症狀、盛行率低，所以就算靈敏度與特異度都很高，陽性裡偽陽性仍佔大多數。陽性是回診的理由，不是診斷。
answer.en: Glandular tissue, fibrous tissue, cysts and calcifications all show white and overlap, looking like asymmetric densities. Those screened have no symptoms and prevalence is low, so even with high sensitivity and specificity, false positives outnumber true ones. A positive is a reason to recall, not a diagnosis.

post.zh: 回診那天會加照、做超音波。十個裡九個，當天就回家了。
post.en: At recall they add views and do an ultrasound. Nine in ten go home the same day.

note.zh: 盛行率決定陽性預測值
note.en: Prevalence sets the positive predictive value

guide.zh: 到工作站接乳房中心電話

sub.zh: 今天會送幾位需回診？五位算多嗎？
sub.en: How many recalls today? Is five a lot?

lines.zh: 目前收到五位需回診。上個月另一區只有兩位。你們這區是不是比較嚴重？
lines.en: Five recalls so far. Another district only sent two last month. Is yours worse?

lines.zh: 問她：那一區篩了幾位？年齡層呢？分母沒出來以前，五和二不能比。
lines.en: Ask her: how many did that district screen, and what ages? Until the denominators are out, five and two cannot be compared.

post.zh: 同樣的檢查，用在盛行率高的族群，陽性預測值就高；用在低的族群，就低。數字不是檢查的錯。
post.en: The same test in a high-prevalence group gives a high positive predictive value; in a low-prevalence group, a low one. The number is not the test's fault.

guide.en: Fill the two-by-two table with Dr Chiu

lines.zh: 紙給你。四格：有病陽性、沒病陽性、有病陰性、沒病陰性。靈敏度看直的，陽性預測值看橫的。
lines.en: Here is the paper. Four cells: diseased positive, healthy positive, diseased negative, healthy negative. Sensitivity reads down a column; positive predictive value reads across a row.

lines.zh: 橫的那一列，沒病陽性那一格最大。那就是美玉阿姨最可能在的格子。
lines.en: Across that row, the healthy-positive cell is the biggest. That is the cell Auntie Mei-Yu is most likely in.

lines.zh: 對。但「最可能」不是「一定」。所以她還是要回診。
lines.en: Yes. But “most likely” is not “certainly”. Which is why she still goes back.

guide.zh: 排出陽性個案的追蹤流程
guide.en: Sequence the follow-up of a positive

lines.zh: 登錄站最後那一欄要填滿，靠的是流程。你排。
lines.en: The last column on the registry only gets filled by a process. You lay it out.

q.zh: 篩檢陽性個案的追蹤流程

steps.zh: 當面或電話通知，說明意義
steps.en: Notify in person or by phone; explain

steps.zh: 轉介並協助預約確診檢查
steps.en: Refer and help book the work-up
Track the result and register it

steps.zh: 回饋受檢者與後續安排
steps.en: Feed back to the person; plan next steps

post.zh: 第三步最常被跳過。沒車、沒假、沒人陪，都是我們的事。
post.en: Step three is the one most often skipped. No bus, no day off, nobody to go with: all of that is our job.

name.en: The people who did not come

note.zh: 十二位沒來；六位在山上
note.en: Twelve missing; six up the hill

guide.zh: 到名單板接里幹事電話
guide.en: Take the community officer's call at the list

sub.zh: 十二位沒來，六位住山上沒公車
sub.en: Twelve did not come; six live up the road with no bus

lines.zh: 名單上十二位沒來。我打了電話，有六位住山上那條路，沒公車，兒女都在外地。
lines.en: Twelve on the list didn't come. I rang round: six live up the hill road, no bus, children working away.

lines.zh: 今天的篩檢率會很好看。但沒來的那十二位，是誰？
lines.en: Today's screening rate will look fine. But who are the twelve who did not come?

post.zh: 可近性的問題不是寄通知能解決的。下週把車開上山，一個早上。
post.en: Access is not fixed by another letter. Next week the van goes up the hill for a morning.

post.zh: 我去借活動中心的場地。阿姨們我一個一個去講。
post.en: I'll book the hall up there. I'll tell the women one by one.

guide.en: Plan the hill trip with Te

lines.zh: 山上那條路，車進得去，但發電機要先檢查，坡度大影像品管要重做一次。
lines.en: The van can get up that road, but the generator needs checking first, and on a slope the phantom has to be redone.

lines.zh: 排在下週三。品管、發電機、名單，三樣我負責。
lines.en: Wednesday next week. Phantom, generator, list: those three are mine.

name.en: A negative is not a guarantee

note.en: A lump found: straight to referral

lines.zh: 這位阿姨說去年篩檢陰性，上個月自己摸到一個硬塊，想說今年再照一次就好。
lines.en: This lady says last year's screen was negative; she found a lump herself last month and thought she'd just have this year's mammogram.

lines.zh: 有症狀的人不走篩檢。這是什麼？
lines.en: Someone with a symptom does not go through screening. What is this?

lines.zh: 可能是間隔癌，也可能不是。但硬塊是紅旗，直接轉診做確診檢查，不等篩檢結果。
lines.en: Possibly an interval cancer, possibly not. But a lump is a red flag: straight to referral for a diagnostic work-up, not waiting for a screening result.

lines.zh: 對。去年的陰性只說去年沒看到，不保證今年。轉診單現在寫。
lines.en: Right. Last year's negative only says nothing was seen last year; it guarantees nothing about this year. Write the referral now.

lines.zh: 我回來問一下……回診那天，我女兒可以陪我進去嗎？
lines.en: I came back to ask… on the recall day, can my daughter come in with me?

lines.zh: 可以。帶著她，帶著今天的單子，不用帶那十篇文章。
lines.en: Yes. Bring her, bring today's slip, and leave the ten articles at home.

lines.zh: 我已經刪了八篇。
lines.en: I've deleted eight already.

lines.zh: 今天三件事：陽性是回診單不是診斷書；陰性不是保證；篩檢率是平均，沒來的人才是分母的另一半。
lines.en: Three things today: a positive is a recall slip, not a diagnosis; a negative is not a guarantee; a screening rate is an average, and the people who did not come are the other half of the denominator.

lines.zh: 這張二乘二表給你。鉛筆字是我老師寫的：先問盛行率。
lines.en: This two-by-two table is yours. The pencilled note is in my own teacher's hand: ask the prevalence first.

lines.zh: 發電機關了。下週三山上見。
lines.en: Generator's off. See you up the hill on Wednesday.

lines.zh: 手機亮了一下。
lines.en: Your phone lights up.

sub.zh: 回診約好了，女兒陪我去
sub.en: Recall booked; my daughter is coming with me

lines.zh: 回診約好了，下週二，女兒請假陪我。剩下兩篇文章也刪了。謝謝你坐下來跟我講。
lines.en: Recall booked for next Tuesday; my daughter has taken the day off. Deleted the last two articles too. Thank you for sitting down with me.

lines.zh: 十個裡的九個，都是這樣回家的。下週二見。
lines.en: Nine out of ten go home exactly like this. See you Tuesday.

sub.zh: 群組裡大家都說是癌，我不想去回診了
sub.en: Everyone in the group chat says cancer; I don't want to go back

lines.zh: 我把片子拍給群組看，大家都說是癌。我整晚睡不著。回診我不想去了，知道了也沒用。
lines.en: I showed the group chat a photo of the image and everyone says cancer. I haven't slept. I don't want the recall any more; knowing won't help.

lines.zh: 阿姨，被叫回去的人大多沒事，那次回診就是為了確認這件事。明天早上我打給您，我們一起約。這是我今天該講清楚的。
lines.en: Auntie, most people recalled are fine, and the recall exists to confirm exactly that. I will phone you tomorrow morning and we will book it together. I should have said this properly today.

lines.zh: 你把那張對折的二乘二表放進外套口袋。下週三，車要上山。
lines.en: You slip the folded two-by-two table into your coat pocket. Next Wednesday, the van goes up the hill.
